name: What kind of return on investment (ROI) can I expect from different types of investment properties?

mainEntity.name: What kind of return on investment (ROI) can I expect from different types of investment properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: The return on investment (ROI) for investment properties varies significantly based on property type (e.g., residential, multi-family, commercial), location, market conditions, and your investment strategy. Residential properties often offer steady rental income and potential appreciation, while commercial properties might yield higher returns but with greater management complexity. Kelby Contreras can help you compare potential ROIs across different property types in locations like Palm Beach or Orange County, guiding you through the practical tradeoffs between risk, liquidity, and expected returns to find the best fit for your financial goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: ROI varies by property type, location, and strategy. Kelby Contreras helps compare potential ROIs and tradeoffs across different property types in various South Florida locations.
